contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), two Victories issue of 318-320, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Helmeted bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [---]A[--]. Reverse description: Two Victories holding shield inscribed VOT / PR over an altar bearing a star, probably eight-pointed. Reverse inscription: VICTORIAE LAETAE[PRINC PERP].
